name: pr-tests
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@50eb4f75b399c710fac55cb76e1a980d159040b2 # v4.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci && npm test
        env:
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

name: issue-intake
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  issues: write
jobs:
  log:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Record new issue
        run: |
          echo "New issue: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}" | tee -a intake.log
          gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --add-label triage
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: preview-on-comment
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  preview:
    if: github.event.issue.pull_request && startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/preview')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ github.event.issue.number }}/head
      - run: make build preview
        env:
          PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

name: pr-report
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["PR Build"]
    types: [completed]
permissions:
  actions: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@ed19e19684a5c6a67c94251b81f29f014ad1cd93 # v4.1.8
        with:
          name: pr-bundle
          run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      - run: bash ./post-build.sh
        env:
          REPORT_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REPORT_API_KEY }}

name: branch-banner
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
permissions:
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  banner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Announce branch
        run: |
          echo "Preview branch: ${{ github.head_ref }}"
          gh pr comment ${{ github.event.number }} --repo ${{ github.repository }} --body "Thanks!"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: triage-bot
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
jobs:
  classify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@93407939409fe37454be6e7d3c1cfa6c225aff8d # v5.3.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: python scripts/triage.py --body "${{ github.event.issue.body }}"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

default:

name: coverage-status
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  actions: write
  checks: write
  statuses: write
jobs:
  status:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - run: make coverage
      - run: gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/statuses/$GITHUB_SHA" -f state=success -f context=coverage -f description="$(cat coverage.txt)"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: build

  packages: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write
  repository-projects: write
jobs:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2

name: ci
on:

    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:

        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.ORG_OWNER_ADMIN_PAT }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@93407939409fe37454be6e7d3c1cfa6c225aff8d # v5.3.0

deploy-web:

name: changed-files
on:

permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v45
        id: changed
      - run: echo "$CHANGED" | xargs -r npx prettier --check
        env:
          CHANGED: ${{ steps.changed.outputs.all_changed_files }}

          wget -q https://downloads.example.com/terraform-provider-acme_1.4.0_linux_amd64.zip
          unzip terraform-provider-acme_1.4.0_linux_amd64.zip -d ~/.terraform.d/plugins/example.com/acme/acme/1.4.0/linux_amd64
      - run: terraform init && terraform plan

name: install-collector

permissions:
  contents: read

name: label-pr
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write
jobs:
  label:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/labeler@0e1cfb17d61a3c176f2d956256d5bc062169a767 # v5.0.0
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ github.token }}
          sync-labels: true

name: pr-title
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, edited]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Validate conventional title
        env:
          PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}
        run: |
          printf '%s\n' "$PR_TITLE"
          grep -Eq '^(feat|fix|docs|chore)(\(.+\))?: ' <<< "$PR_TITLE"

name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write
jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - run: make dist && (cd dist && sha256sum * > SHA256SUMS)
      - uses: sigstore/cosign-installer@248edf41b823ab12ddb23c555e8acb15dc3d2777 # v3.7.0
      - run: cosign sign-blob --yes --bundle dist/SHA256SUMS.bundle dist/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@3ca3e089cf67e7fe487ab92fae2ea8c874e60f39 # v1.4.4
        with:
          subject-path: dist/*
      - run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/*
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

name: deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    environment: production
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@7622e5dcf0836f63af4d4710e077367652a5a72b # v4.0.2
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-ecs-deploy
          aws-region: eu-west-1
      - run: aws ecs update-service --cluster payments --service api --force-new-deployment

name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    container:
      image: node:20-bookworm@sha256:9716094a1a2b9abd3f87d4b5c72d99a1c93f8794624a9f112418999347b3679e
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npm test

name: tools
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@e1b3f47a14701a33c3b97f36989c80fb670bb130 # v4.2.2
      - name: Install kubeconform
        run: |
          curl -fsSLO https://dl.example.com/kubeconform/0.6.7/kubeconform-linux-amd64.tar.gz
          echo "5f1c2e8a9b0d3c4e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e  kubeconform-linux-amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar xzf kubeconform-linux-amd64.tar.gz
      - run: ./kubeconform -strict k8s/

default:
  image: node:20-bookworm@sha256:9716094a1a2b9abd3f87d4b5c72d99a1c93f8794624a9f112418999347b3679e

stages: [test, deploy]

test:
  stage: test
  script:
    - npm ci --ignore-scripts
    - npm test

deploy:
  stage: deploy
  environment: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main"
  script:
    - ./scripts/deploy.sh

stages: [deploy]

rollout:
  stage: deploy
  image: ghcr.io/example/deploy-tools:1.6.0@sha256:6b3198626887fddd6b5bc5d279e38b77104d86c4d30df36c7c3967d4de6dbcf5
  environment: production
  rules:
    - if: $CI_COMMIT_TAG
  script:
    - cosign verify --key cosign.pub "registry.example.com/api@${IMAGE_DIGEST}"
    - kubectl -n api set image deploy/api api="registry.example.com/api@${IMAGE_DIGEST}"
